title: Schema changes for algorithm selection, fail-stack settings, agent library, seed, step diagnostics and HPO
purpose: Concentrate every remaining model change in one spec and one linear migration chain so that feature specs never edit model files in parallel (ADR-006).

public_interfaces.signature:
class Agent(Base):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=20)
    market = models.ForeignKey(Market, on_delete=models.CASCADE, null=True, blank=True)
    state = enum.EnumField(AgentState, null=True, default=AgentState.CREATED)
    budget = models.DecimalField(decimal_places=2, max_digits=12, default=0)
    type = enum.EnumField(AgentType, null=True, default=AgentType.FOSSIL)
    algorithm_type = enum.EnumField(AlgorithmType, default=AlgorithmType.DDPG)
    failstack_enabled = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    failstack_limit = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=6)
    failstack_delta = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, default=Decimal('15'))
    failstack_min_margin = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=4, default=Decimal('0'))
    source = models.ForeignKey('self', null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, related_name='copies')
    runtime_policy: 'BaseAgentAlgorithm | None' = None

    class Meta:
        constraints = [
            UniqueConstraint(Lower('name'), condition=Q(market__isnull=True), name='uniq_library_agent_name_ci'),
            UniqueConstraint(fields=['market', 'name'], name='uniq_agent_name_per_market'),
            CheckConstraint(check=Q(market__isnull=False) | Q(proxy=True), name='library_agent_is_proxy'),
            CheckConstraint(check=Q(failstack_limit__gte=1), name='failstack_limit_gte_1'),
            CheckConstraint(check=Q(failstack_delta__gte=0), name='failstack_delta_gte_0'),
        ]

    @property
    def is_library(self) -> bool
    @property
    def is_baseline(self) -> bool
public_interfaces.description: runtime_policy replaces the class attribute 'algorithm = 0'. It is a plain class-level default None, never a model field. Use 'condition=' for UniqueConstraint and 'check=' for CheckConstraint as supported by Django 5.0 (Django 5.1 renames check to condition, keep 5.0 syntax as pinned in requirements.txt). is_library = proxy and market_id is None. is_baseline = algorithm_type in registry.BASELINE_TYPES.
Seed stored with every run (1.10). Default keeps the current constant for existing rows. Range checked 0 <= seed < 2**32 by CheckConstraint 'simulation_seed_range'.

public_interfaces.signature:
class AgentStepLog(models.Model):
    agent = models.ForeignKey(Agent, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='step_logs')
    period = models.ForeignKey(Period, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='step_logs')
    reward = models.FloatField(null=True)
    critic_loss = models.FloatField(null=True)
    actor_loss = models.FloatField(null=True)
    mean_q = models.FloatField(null=True)
    exploration_scale = models.FloatField(null=True)
    intervened_plants = models.JSONField(default=list)
    learning_active = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    evaluation_phase = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    extra = models.JSONField(default=dict)

    class Meta:
        constraints = [UniqueConstraint(fields=['agent', 'period'], name='uniq_steplog_agent_period')]
        indexes = [models.Index(fields=['agent', 'period'])]
public_interfaces.description: One row per agent step. period is the decision period t, reward refers to the outcome of t-1. Plain models.Model (no Base) to keep rows small. Float fields reject NaN/Inf at the service layer (step_logger).

public_interfaces.signature:
class HPOStudy(Base):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    algorithm_type = enum.EnumField(AlgorithmType)
    scenario = models.ForeignKey(Simulation, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name='hpo_studies', limit_choices_to={'proxy': True})
    param_bounds = models.JSONField()
    fixed_params = models.JSONField(default=dict)
    colony_size = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    max_iter = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    limit = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    search_seeds = models.JSONField()
    evaluation_seeds = models.JSONField()
    objective = models.JSONField()
    status = enum.EnumField(HPOStatus, default=HPOStatus.CREATED)
    started_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    finished_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    best_params = models.JSONField(null=True, blank=True)
    best_score = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True)
    error = models.TextField(blank=True, default='')
    cancel_requested = models.BooleanField(default=False)
public_interfaces.description: Fields exactly as PLAN 2.4 plus fixed_params (ADR-009). CheckConstraints: colony_size >= 2, max_iter >= 1, limit >= 1. JSON shapes are validated in hpo_service (param_bounds: {name: {low, high, scale}}, seeds: list of distinct ints, search and evaluation seed sets disjoint).

public_interfaces.signature:
class HPOTrial(Base):
    study = models.ForeignKey(HPOStudy, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='trials')
    iteration = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    phase = enum.EnumField(HPOPhase)
    source_index = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    params = models.JSONField()
    seed = models.IntegerField()
    agent_score = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True)
    market_score = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True)
    simulation = models.OneToOneField(Simulation, null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, related_name='hpo_trial')
    status = enum.EnumField(HPOTrialStatus, default=HPOTrialStatus.PENDING)
    duration_s = models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True)
    error = models.TextField(blank=True, default='')
public_interfaces.description: One row per (candidate, seed) evaluation. A candidate is identified by (study, iteration, phase, source_index). OneToOne to the evaluation simulation so 'Simulation.objects.filter(proxy=False, hpo_trial__isnull=True)' lists user runs only. Index on (study, iteration, phase).

public_interfaces.signature:
class HPOStatus(enum.Enum): CREATED = 0, RUNNING = 1, FINISHED = 2, FAILED = 3, CANCELED = 4
class HPOPhase(enum.Enum): INIT = 0, EMPLOYED = 1, ONLOOKER = 2, SCOUT = 3, FINAL_EVAL = 4
class HPOTrialStatus(enum.Enum): PENDING = 0, RUNNING = 1, FINISHED = 2, FAILED = 3
public_interfaces.description: FINAL_EVAL added for held-out seed re-measurement (1.11, ADR-009).

migrations.name: 0006_agent_algorithm_failstack
migrations.kind: AddField x5 (algorithm_type, failstack_enabled, failstack_limit, failstack_delta, failstack_min_margin) + check constraints for failstack

migrations.name: 0008_agent_library_import
algorithm: Pre-check: for every market, names must be unique (case-sensitive, matching the constraint). If duplicates exist, raise RuntimeError listing them (no silent renaming).
Collect existing library names (proxy=True, market NULL) lower-cased into a set.

Deduplication (OQ-15): group scenario agents by configuration key (type, budget, algorithm_type, failstack fields, sorted tuple of (resource_id, capacity)). Each group yields ONE library agent named after its lowest-id member. The suffix rule in the next step applies only when that name is already taken by a library agent with a different configuration. Every member gets source = that library agent.

For each scenario agent (proxy=True, market not NULL), ordered by id: base = agent.name. candidate = base. While candidate.lower() in names: candidate = increment_suffix(candidate) (same semantics as views.increment_suffix: '_2', then '_3', ...), truncating the base so len(candidate) <= 20. Create the library agent (market NULL, proxy True, same budget, type, algorithm_type, failstack fields, state CREATED), copy its Portfolio and Plants with proxy True, add candidate.lower() to names, set scenario agent.source = library agent.
Existing library agents with colliding names among themselves (if any): rename later ones with the same suffix rule and log.

Reverse: delete library agents created by this migration (identified by being the source of a scenario agent and created in this migration, tracked via a temporary marker in Agent.state or by created_at window recorded at forward time), set source to NULL.

migrations.name: 0010_simulation_fields_agentsteplog
migrations.kind: AddField Simulation.seed (+ constraint), Simulation.observation_lags (JSONField, default [1, 24], allowed [1, 24] or [1, 24, 168]), Simulation.evaluation_periods (PositiveIntegerField, default 0, must be < periodNumber), Simulation.error (TextField, blank). CreateModel AgentStepLog. SimulationState.FAILED is a new enum member. django_enumfield stores ints, so there is no schema change, but enums.py is edited in this wave.

migrations.name: 0012_algorithm_params
migrations.kind: AddField Agent.algorithm_params (JSONField, default dict). CreateModel AlgorithmDefault (algorithm_type unique, params JSON, updated_at) (OQ-9)

invariants: After 0008 every scenario agent of the four proxy scenarios has a non-NULL source pointing to a library agent with identical type, budget and plant set.
After 0009 no two library agents share a name case-insensitively and no market holds two agents with the same name.
Agent.runtime_policy is never saved and is None on freshly loaded instances.
Deleting a library agent leaves its copies intact with source NULL.
Deleting a proxy scenario referenced by an HPOStudy raises ProtectedError.
edge_cases: Name of exactly 20 characters needing a suffix: base truncated to 18 characters + '_2'.
Name already ending in '_2': next candidate '_3' (increment_suffix semantics).
Case variants 'Coal' and 'COAL': collide in the library.
Market NULL with proxy False: rejected by library_agent_is_proxy.
failstack_limit 0 or negative delta: rejected by check constraints.
Migration run on an empty DB (tests): forward and reverse are no-ops without errors.
Existing scenario 32499 'test' with 2 agents: imported like the others.
